gist: Wales beat New Zealand 35-28 to secure their first victory against them in 73 years.
The match took place in Cardiff at the Principality Stadium in front of 55,152 fans.
A resilient defensive display in the final quarter helped Wales hold off the All Blacks.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Wales defeated New Zealand 35-28 in a nine-try Nations Championship match at the Principality Stadium, ending a 34-match losing sequence stretching back to 1953. Tries from Tomos Williams, Dewi Lake, Archie Griffin, Eddie James and Louis Rees-Zammit helped Wales build a lead. New Zealand responded through Cortez Ratima, Wallace Sititi, Fehi Fineanganofo and Peter Lakai, but Wales held firm with a crucial defensive display.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: The win broke a 73-year winless run against the All Blacks, lifting a nation and providing a famous moment for Welsh rugby after a difficult period on and off the field.

articles.title: England boxer missed Worlds over sex-test mix-up
articles.standfirst: George Francis was left “broken” after he was banned from competing at the Under-19 World Championships because his team did not organise a sex verification test to prove he is male.

gist: George Francis missed the Under-19 World Championships due to a sex-test mix-up.
England Boxing admitted an administrative oversight caused the missed test.
Francis is now planning to turn professional after missing the tournament.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Eighteen-year-old boxer George Francis was barred from competing at the Under-19 World Championships in Montenegro because England Boxing forgot to organise his mandatory sex verification test. The governing body admitted an administrative oversight occurred and that a resolution was not possible.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: World Boxing introduced mandatory genetic sex testing rules to ensure safety and a level playing field. The mistake cost Francis the chance to represent England in his first World Championships and potentially qualify for the Olympics.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.text: Francis is planning to turn professional after stating there is nothing really left for him as an amateur. England Boxing stated it is committed to strengthening processes to prevent a recurrence.

fivew: An English boxer missed the Under-19 World Championships due to a missing sex verification test.
Governing body England Boxing forgot to organise a sex verification test.
